[b]Operation Name: "New Horizon"
Date: April 2, 2025
Location: Unclaimed Territory, Northern Mainland of West Shamat
Objective: Establish a Sikirskian outpost and secure a foothold for future expansion.[/b]

[i]Log Entry 001  Arrival at Mainland
Unit: 1st Sikirskian Expeditionary Battalion
Log by: Sergeant Ilya Novikov
Time: 08:45 AM[/i]

[i]"We've landed. As soon as we stepped off the craft, it hit usthe air was warm. Not the biting cold we're used to, not the sharp wind cutting through your bones. Just warm. Feels strange, almost unnatural. The men are shedding their heavy coats already, but we keep them close. Orders are clear: secure the landing zone, clear a perimeter, and establish the first structures. Colonel Ivanov wants a command post set up by sundown. This land may be unclaimed, but it's not necessarily empty."
[/i]

[b][i]Log Entry 002  First Impressions[/b]
Unit: Civilian Exploration Group "Dirt"
Log by: Expedition Leader Nina Vasilyeva
Time: 11:30 AM[/i]

[i]"The ground here is differentsofter, looser. Back home, everything is either frozen or wet. Here, were stepping on something that actually crumbles under our boots. Feels odd. Some of the settlers have started setting up tents, but the soldiers are doing most of the work for now. Weve been assigned sectorsGroup A is digging latrines, Group B is working on setting up water collection, and Group C is securing shelter. No one knows what animals live here, what plants are safe. Everything is new. Everything is almost wierd."[/i]

[quote=bantarus;58994177]Jorik III. studied Marcus with quiet intensity, his fingers drumming against the hilt of his dagger. The words of the Legatus were direct, his request clear, Versia sought more than trade. It sought a bond of steel and war. Around them, the hall was still alive with the sounds of feasting and laughter, but at the High Table, the weight of the conversation had shifted.
For a long moment, Jorik remained silent, letting the tension linger. Then, a slow, knowing smile spread across his lips.
"You ask much, Legatus," he finally said, his voice smooth yet firm. "An alliance between warriors is not a bargain of coin or parchment—it is an oath, forged in blood and upheld by steel. If Jomsland stands with Vers, we do so with the full might of our fleets, our warriors, and our honor. But such a bond is not given lightly."He gestured to Jarl Freyderic, who leaned forward, his expression thoughtful. "Gold and iron are valuable, yes," the Jarl said, "but trust is the foundation of war-brothers. If we bleed for you, we must know you will do the same for us."
Joriks sharp blue eyes locked onto Marcus. "You say your enemies are growing. That your expansion has drawn their gaze. If you truly seek protection and strength, then Jomsland will offer you not just an alliance, but a place within the Elseyran Defense Union."The name carried weight, and the warriors at the table exchanged glances. The EDU was no mere agreement, it was a brotherhood of nations bound by the promise of mutual defense, an alliance forged to counter threats both seen and unseen across Elseyr."With this," Jorik continued, "Versia would stand beside Jomsland and others in a pact of steel, prepared to defend one another from any who dare strike against us. Your expansion invites war, Legatus, but wars are not fought alone. If your Rex wishes true protection, this is the path he should consider."He let the words sink in before leaning forward, his gaze never wavering. "However, I do not believe in resting Jomslands fate on a council of distant rulers alone. I am willing to offer another thing aswell, a separate alliance between Jomsland and Versia. One forged in our own terms. If your king values strength, then let us make a pact that goes beyond mere defense, one that secures prosperity, trade, and military cooperation between our peoples, bound by the warriors oath."[/quote]
(I just read the edu factbook)

[i]Marcus thought long and hard. Joining the EDU as it currently stood would be challenging for Versia. Versia's centralized, top-down government would need to restructure its view of it's own  citizens and the military, and it might require loosening restrictions on state-controlled goods, thus diluting the Rex's power. If Versia joined the EDU, Marcus thought, it could spark division and unrest after a millennium of unwavering state control. A bead of sweat trickled down his face.

"My King... I ask that we form a bilateral pact between our two nations, one forged on our own terms. Of course, I mean no offense."[/i]
